senses.gloss:
क्शा क्शा, a root forming, according to
native grammarians, some tenses of ख्या
and चक्ष् (e. g. the Fut. क्शास्यति; Inf. क्शातुम्;
Aor. अक्शासीत्, अक्शास्त; Perf. चक्शे).

क्ष क्ष, अस्, m. (fr. 4. क्षि), destruction; loss,
disappearance; destruction of the world; lightning; a
field; the protector or cultivator of a field, a peasant,
a husbandman; a demon or Rakṣas; the fourth in-
carnation of Viṣṇu as the man-lion or नर-सिंह.

क्षज् क्षज् or क्षञ्ज्, cl. 1. A. क्षजते
or क्षञ्जते, चक्षञ्जे, क्षञ्जितुम्, to
go, approach; to give; cl. 10. P. क्षञ्जयति, -यि-
तुम्, to live in distress; to live in pain or want.
क्षण् क्षण्, क्षणन. See क्षन्.

क्षण क्षण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be a
corruption of ईक्षण, a glance, and not used in the
earlier literature; native lexicographers make this
word m. only), any instantaneous point of time, an
instant, the twinkling of an eye, a moment (e. g.
क्षणम्, acc., or क्षणेन, inst. for an instant, in
a moment; क्षणात्, abl. after an instant, immedi-
ately, directly, at once; क्षणे क्षणे, every instant,
every moment; तत्-क्षणम्, that very moment,
in that same moment, immediately; तत्-क्षणात्,
immediately upon that); a moment regarded as a
measure of time, equal to thirty Kalas or four minutes,
or according to other authorities equal to (4/5) or (2/3) (4/5)
seconds; a leisure moment, a vacant instant, leisure,
(क्षणं कृ, to have leisure for, wait patiently for;
cf. कृत-क्षण); a fit or suitable moment, an
opportunity, (क्षणं कृ or दा, to give an oppor-
tunity); a festival; a certain day of the fortnight, as
the full moon, change of the moon, &c.; dependance,
servitude; the centre, the middle.
—क्षण-क्षेप,
अस्, m. a momentary delay.
—क्षण-द, अस्, m. an
astrologer; (आ), f. night (giving leisure); turmeric;
(अम्), n. night-blindness; water.
—क्षणदा-कर,
अस्, m. the moon.
—क्षणदा-चर, अस्, ई, m. f. a
night-walker, a Rakṣas, a fiend, a goblin.
—क्ष-
णदान्ध्य (˚द-आन्˚), अम्, n. night-blindness, nycta-
lopsis; [cf. क्षपान्ध्य, नक्तान्ध्य.]
—क्षण-
दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, momentarily visible, seen for
an instant.
—क्षण-द्युति, इस्, f. momentary flash,
lightning; [cf. अचिर-द्युति and क्षण-प्रभा.]
—क्षण-निश्वास, अस्, m. a porpoise, the Gangetic
porpoise.
—क्षण-प्रकाशा, f. lightning.
—क्ष-
ण-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, gleaming or flashing for an
instant; (आ), f. lightning.
—क्षण-भङ्गुर, अस्,
आ, अम्, perishing in an instant, transient, frail, perish-
able.
—क्षण-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, momentary, short-
lived.
—क्षण-मात्रम्, ind. for an instant merely,
only for a moment.
—क्षण-मात्रानुरागिन् (˚त्र-
अन्˚), ई, इणी, इ, one whose affection lasts only a mo-
ment.
—क्षण-रामिन्, ई, m. a pigeon.
—क्षण-
विघ्न, अम्, n. a momentary hindrance.
—क्षण-
विध्वंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, collapsing or perishing in a
moment; (ई), m. the name of a sect of atheistic
philosophers who deny the continued identity of any
part of nature, and maintain that the universe perishes
and undergoes a new creation every instant.
—क्ष-
णान्तर (˚ण-अन्˚), अम्, n. the interval of a moment;
(ए), ind. after a little while, the next moment, there-
upon.
—क्षणार्ध (˚ण-अर्˚), अम्, n. half the
measure of time called Kṣaṇa, half a moment, a
small space of time.

क्षणिक, अस्, आ, अम्, momentary, transient; (आ),
f. lightning.
—क्षणिक-त्व, अम्, n. momentary
duration.
क्षणित, अस्, आ, अम्, having a leisure moment.
क्षणतु क्षणतु, &c. See under rt. क्षन्.
क्षणतु, उस्, m. a wound or sore.
क्षत्तृ क्षत्तृ. See under rt. क्षद्.

क्षत्तृ, ता, m. one who cuts anything, one who
carves or distributes; an attendant; a door-keeper,
[]
a porter; a charioteer, a coachman; [cf. अनु-क्षत्-
तृ]; one who fights from a chariot; the son of a
Śūdra man and a Kṣatriya woman, or the son of a
Kṣatriya man and a Śūdra woman (called Ugra
in Manu X. 9), or the son of a Śūdra man and
Vaiśya woman (called Āyogava in Manu X. 12);
the son of a female slave; (the proper employment of
a Kṣattṛ is said to be catching animals that live in
holes); a N. of Vidura as the son of a female slave,
his father being the celebrated Vyāsa (see Mahā-bh.
1. 7381); an epithet of Brahmā; a fish.

क्षत्र क्षत्र, अम्, अस्, n. m. (probably fr.
rt. 1. क्षि; the m. form does not appear to occur),
dominion, supremacy, power, might (whether human
or supernatural, in the Veda especially applied to the
power of Varuṇa-Mitra and Indra); government,
governing body, the military or reigning order (the
members of which in the earliest times, as represented
by the Vedic hymns, were generally called Rājanya,
not Kṣatriya; afterwards, when the difference be-
tween Brahman and Kṣatra or the priestly and civil
authorities became more distinct, the reigning or
[]
military caste accepted the title Kṣatriya); a man
of the second or Kṣatriya caste, a warrior, a soldier
(in this sense fancifully derived in Raghu. II. 53. fr.
क्षतात् त्र fr. rt. त्रै, i. e. a preserver from injury);
(ई), f. a woman of the second caste; the rank of a
member of the reigning or military order, the
authority of the second caste; wealth; water; the
body; N. of a plant, = तगर; [cf. तुवि-क्षत्र,
देव-क्षत्र, &c.]
—क्षत्र-धर्म, अस्, m.
the duty of a Kṣatriya, bravery, military conduct.
—क्षत्र-धर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having the duties of a
soldier or of the second caste; (आ), m., N. of a prince.
—क्षत्रधर्मानुग (˚म-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
following or observing the duty of a soldier.
—क्ष-
त्र-धृति, इस्, f. the support of supreme power; N.
of a particular part of the Rāja-sūya ceremony.
—क्षत्र-प, अस्, m. a governor, a Satrap (a word
found on coins).
—क्षत्र-पति, इस्, m., Ved. the
possessor of dominion.
—क्षत्र-बन्धु, उस्, ऊस् or
उस्, उ, one who belongs to the military order or second
caste; (उस्), m. a member of the Kṣatriya caste; a
mere Kṣatriya, i. e. a Kṣatriya by birth but not by
his actions (a term of abuse).
—क्षत्रबन्धु-वत्,
ind. like a warrior.
—क्षत्र-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
one who holds or confers dominion.
—क्षत्र-
योग, अस्, m., Ved. union of the princely order.
—क्षत्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, endowed with princely
dignity.
—क्षत्र-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. favourable
to the princely order.
—क्षत्र-वर्धन, अस्, ई,
अम्, Ved. promoting dominion.
—क्षत्र-विद्या, f.
the knowledge or science possessed by the Kṣatriya
or military order.
—क्षत्र-वृक्ष, अस्, m., N. of
a tree, = मुचुकुन्द.
—क्षत्र-वृद्ध, अस्, m.,
N. of a prince.
—क्षत्र-वृद्धि, इस्, m., N. of one
of the sons of Manu Raucya.
—क्षत्र-वृध्, त्,
m., N. of a prince, = क्षत्र-वृद्ध.
—क्षत्र-
वेद, अस्, m., the Veda of the Kṣatriya or military
order.
—क्षत्र-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. possessing
sovereignty; (Sāy.) possessed of power.
—क्षत्र-
सव, अस्, m., N. of a sacrificial ceremony.
—क्ष-
त्रायतनीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. क्षत्र + आयतन),
Ved. based on the Kṣatra or kingly power.
—क्ष-
त्रोपक्षत्र (˚र-उप्˚), अस्, m., N. of a prince.
—क्षत्रौजस् (˚र-ओज्˚), आस्, m., N. of a prince.

क्षात्त्र क्षात्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. क्षत्तृ), Ved.
a community or number of attendants or servants.

क्षात्र क्षात्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. क्षत्र), be-
longing or relating to or peculiar to the second or
military tribe; (अम्), n. the second or military tribe;
the dignity of a ruler or governor.
क्षत्रिण, अस्, m., N. of a man.

क्षत्रिन्, ई, m. a man of the military order or
second caste.

क्षत्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, governing, endowed with
sovereignty; (अस्), m. a member of the military
or reigning order which in later time constituted the
second caste; (आ), f. a woman of the military
order or of the second caste; (ई), f. the wife of a
man of the second caste; (अम्), n. the power or
rank of this order.
—क्षत्रिय-जाति, इस्, f. the mili-
tary tribe or caste.
—क्षत्रिय-ता, f. or क्षत्रिय-
त्व, अम्, n. the order or rank of a Kṣatriya.
—क्षत्रिय-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty or occupa-
tion of the warrior-tribe, war, government, &c.
—क्षत्रिय-धर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having the duties
of a soldier or of the second caste.
—क्षत्रिय-
प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, mostly consisting of the military
tribe.
—क्षत्रिय-मर्दन, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying
or destroyer of Kṣatriyas.
—क्षत्रिय-राज, अस्, m.
the chief of Kṣatriyas.
—क्षत्रियर्षभ (˚य-
ऋष्˚), अस्, m. best of Kṣatriyas.
—क्षत्रिय-
हण, अस्, m. one who destroys the military caste.
—क्षत्रियान्तकर (˚य-अन्˚), अस्, m. one who
destroys the Kṣatriyas.

क्षत्रियका or इका, f. a woman belonging to the
military or reigning order, a woman of the second
caste.

क्षत्रियाणी, f. a woman belonging to the mili-
tary caste; the wife of a man of the second caste.

क्षद् क्षद्, cl. 1. A., Ved. क्षदते,
चक्षदे, to cut, dissect, cut to pieces,
divide; to kill; to carve (meat), to distribute (food);
to take (food), to consume, eat. (As a Sautra root
क्षद् means ‘to cover, protect, shelter.’)

क्षदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, carving, dividing, tearing;
eating.

क्षदन, अम्, n. the act of carving, dividing,
tearing; eating.

क्षद्मन्, अ, n., Ved. a carving knife; pieces of
food cut off or carved; (according to Schol.) water.

क्षन् क्षन् or क्षण्, cl. 8. P. A. क्ष-
णोति, -णुते, चक्षाण, चक्षणे, क्ष-
णिष्यति, -ते, अक्षणीत्, क्षणितुम्, P. to hurt,
injure, wound, break; A. to hurt one's self, be injured
or wounded: Caus. क्षाणयति, -यितुम्: Desid.
चिक्षणिषति, -ते: Intens. चङ्क्षण्यते, चङ्क्-
षन्ति; [cf. Gr. καίνω, κανῶ; καίνυται = क्षणुते;
ξαίνω; perhaps also σίνομαι for ξίνομαι.]

क्षणन, अम्, n. hurting, injuring; killing,
slaughter.
क्षणनु, उस्, m. a wound, a sore.

क्षत, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded, hurt, hit, injured,
broken, torn, rent, destroyed, impaired, violated;
diminished, trodden or broken down; (अम्), n. a
hurt, wound, sore, contusion.
—क्षत-कास, अस्, m.
a cough produced by an injury; [cf. क्षत-ज, &c.]
—क्षत-घ्न, अस्, m., N. of a plant, commonly
Kukuraśoṅkhā, Conyza Lacera; (आ or ई), f. a kind
of insect; lac, the animal dye.
—क्षत-ज, अस्, आ,
अम्, produced by a wound or injury of any kind (e. g.
कास, a kind of cough); (अम्), n. blood; pus, matter.
—क्षत-तेजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, dimmed, obscured (as
light or power).
—क्षत-पुण्य-लेश, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the stock of merit exhausted.
—क्षत-योनि,
इस्, f. a woman who has been violated, one no longer
a virgin.
—क्षत-विक्षत, अस्, आ, अम्, mangled,
covered with cuts and wounds.
—क्षत-विध्वंसिन्,
ई, m. a sort of pot-herb, Convolvulus Argenteus.
—क्षत-वृत्ति, इस्, f. destitution, the being without
the means of support, living on what one can get.
—क्षत-व्रण, अस्, m. a sore produced by an
injury.
—क्षत-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, a violator of a
vow or religious engagement.
—क्षत-हर, अम्,
n. Agallochum or Aloe wood.
—क्षतारि (˚त-अरि),
इस्, इस्, इ, victorious, triumphant.
—क्षतोत्थ (˚त-
उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, produced by injury.
—क्षतोदर
(˚त-उद्˚), अम्, n. flux, dysentery.
—क्षतोद्भव
(˚त-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, produced by injury; (अम्),
n. (?) blood; [cf. क्षत-ज.]
—क्षतौजस् (˚त-
ओज्˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, weakened, reduced, impaired.

क्षति, इस्, f. injury, hurt, a wound; destruction;
damage, disadvantage.

क्षाति क्षाति, इस्, f. (fr. क्षै), Ved. singeing,
scorching, heat.

क्षप् 1. क्षप्, cl. 1. P. A. क्षपति, -ते, to
be abstinent, to fast, to do penance: Caus.
क्षपयति, -यितुम्, to regret sorrowfully, miss.

क्षप् 3. क्षप्. See Caus. of rt. 4. क्षि,
‘to destroy.’

4. क्षप्, प्, f., Ved. night; a measure of time
equivalent to a whole day of twenty-four hours;
darkness; water; क्षपः or क्षपा, ind. at
night; [cf. Lat. crepus-culum; Gr. κνέφος, κνέφας.]
—क्षपोत्यय (˚पस्-अत्˚), अस्, m. the end of night.

1. क्षपण, अस्, m. a Buddhist mendicant; (अस्,
आ, अम्), shameless, impudent?; (अम्), n. abstinence,
chastisement of the body, defilement, impurity.

2. क्षपण, अस्, आ, अम्, destructive, one who
destroys; (अम्), n. destroying, diminishing, suppress-
ing, expelling.

क्षपणक, अस्, m. a mendicant, especially a
Buddhist mendicant, who wears no garments; also
a Jaina mendicant; (अस्), m., N. of an author
supposed to have lived at the court of king Vikra-
māditya.
क्षपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, casting, sending.
क्षपित, अस्, आ, अम्, sent, cast, directed.

क्षपा, f. night (Ved. only used in inst. pl.
क्षपाभिस्); turmeric.
—क्षपा-कर, अस्, m.
‘making the night,’ the moon.
—क्षपा-घन,
अस्, m. a dark cloud or dark nocturnal clouds.
—क्ष-
पा-चर, अस्, m. a night-walker; a fiend, a goblin.
—क्षपाट (˚पा-अट), अस्, m. a night-walker; a
Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin.
—क्षपा-नाथ, अस्,
m. the moon.
—क्षपान्त (˚पा-अन्˚), अस्, m. dawn,
day-break.
—क्षपान्ध्य (˚पा-आन्˚), अम्, n. night-
blindness, nyctalopsis; [cf. क्षणदान्ध्य, नक्-
तान्ध्य.]
—क्षपा-पति, इस्, m. the moon; cam-
phor.
—क्षपाह (˚पा-अहन्), अम्, n. a day and night.
क्षपणी क्षपणी, f. = क्षेपणी, an oar, a net.

क्षपण्यु क्षपण्यु, उस्, m. an offence, a
transgression.

क्षम् 1. क्षम्, cl. 1. A., 4. P. क्षमते,
क्षाम्यति (ep. also 1. P. and Ved. 2. P.
क्षमति, क्षमिति), चक्षमे, चक्षाम, क्ष-
मिष्यते, -ति, and क्षंस्यते, -ति, अक्षमिष्ट,
अक्षंस्त, अक्षमत्, क्षमितुम् and क्षन्तुम्,
to be patient or composed, to suppress anger, keep quiet;
to submit to (with dat.); to bear patiently, endure, put
up with, suffer; to pardon, forgive (with gen. or dat.
of the person, e. g. क्षमस्व तद् मे, forgive me
that); to allow, permit, suffer; to resist; to be com-
petent or able to do anything (with inf.): Caus.
क्षमयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to ask pardon for anything
(with double acc., e. g. तत् क्षमये भवन्तम्,
I ask you to pardon that); to suffer or bear patiently:
Desid. चिक्षमिषते, -ति, and चिक्षंसते, -ति:
Intens. चङ्क्षम्यते, चङ्क्षन्ति; [cf. Goth.
hramja (?); Angl. Sax. hremman, ‘to hinder,
disquiet.’]

2. क्षम्, f. (making क्षास् in the nom. case),
Ved. the ground, the earth, χθών; [cf. χαμαί. &c.]
—क्ष-पावत्, आन्, m., Ved. an earth-protector,
a ruler, a governor.

क्षन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be borne or endured,
bearable, to be suffered or submitted to patiently, to
be pardoned or forgiven.

क्षन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, pardoning, bearing patiently,
submissive.

क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, patient; enduring, suffering,
bearing, submissive, resisting; adequate, competent, able,
fit for (with inf. or at the end of a compound, वयं
त्यक्तुं क्षमाः, we are able to quit; गमन-
क्षम, able to go); friendly; favourable; bear-
able, tolerable; fit, appropriate, becoming suitable,
proper for (with gen. of the person, e. g. क्ष-
मं कौरवाणाम्, proper for the Kauravas; or with
inf., e. g. न स क्षमः कोपयितुम्, he is not a
fit object for anger); (अस्), m. a N. of Śiva, ‘the
patient;’ (आ), f. patience, forbearance, indulgence; per-
sonified as a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Pulaha;
resistance; the earth; an epithet of Durgā; N. of a
female shepherd; the tree Acacia Catechu (खदिर);
N. of a species of the Atijayatī metre [cf. उत्पलिनी];
night (wrong form for क्षपा); (अम्), n. propriety,
fitness; [cf. Hib. cam, ‘strong, stout, mighty; power,
might;’ cama, ‘brave.’]
—क्षम-ता, f. or क्ष-
म-त्व, अम्, n. ability, fitness, capability.
—क्षम-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, knowing what is proper or right.
—क्षमा-कल्याण, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of
Jinalābhasūri, who composed 1794 A. D. a com-
mentary on the Jīva-vicāra.
—क्षमा-तल, अम्, n.
the earth.
—क्षमा-दंश, अस्, m., N. of a tree,
= शिग्रु.
—क्षमान्वित (˚मा-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
endowed with patience, patient, enduring, forgiving.
—क्षमा-पति, इस्, m. lord of the earth, a king.
—क्षमापन्न (˚मा-आप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, forbearing,
patient.
—क्षमा-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, very patient, for-
[]
bearing.
—क्षमा-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, patient; (क्), m.
a king, a prince.
—क्षमा-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, en-
dowed with patience, patient, enduring.
—क्षमा-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, patient, enduring, forbearing; (अती),
f., N. of the wife of Nidhi-pati.

क्षमा (inst. case of 2. क्षम्), on the earth, on
the floor (included by Pāṇini among the indeclinables
with स्वर्, दिवा, &c.); [cf. Gr. χαμαί, χαμᾶ-ζε,
χαμά-θεν, χθαμαλός.]
—क्षमा-चर, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. being in the ground or under the earth.

क्षाम क्षाम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. क्षै),
scorched, singed; dried up, emaciated, wasted, fallen
away, thin, slim, slender; weak, debilitated, infirm,
slight.
—क्षाम-ता, f. or क्षाम-त्व, अम्, n.
emaciation, thinness, slenderness; debility.
—क्षा-
म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. scorching, singeing, dry-
ing up; epithet of Agni; (ती), f., scil. इष्टि, N. of a
particular sacrificial ceremony.
—क्षामास्य (˚म-
आस्˚), अम्, n. any diet or any state of the body (as
menstruation) incompatible with a particular medical
treatment.
क्षाम, अस्, आ, अम्, wasted, dried up. See s. v.

क्षमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suffered, to be
patiently borne; to be pardoned.

क्षमापय, nom. P. A. -पयति, -ते, -यितुम्,
to ask any one's (acc.) pardon, to beg forgiveness.

क्षमितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be endured, to be
patiently borne, to be pardoned.

क्षमितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, patient, enduring, for-
bearing, indulgent.

क्षमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, patient, enduring, forbearing,
indulgent; capable, able.

क्षम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the earth,
terrestrial; χθόνιος.

क्षाम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be borne; to be pardoned
or overlooked.

क्षान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, borne, endured; patient,
enduring; (अस्), m., N. of a man; of a hunter; epi-
thet of Śiva [cf. क्षम]; (आ), f. the earth, ‘the
patient one.’
क्षान्त क्षान्त, &c. See under 1. क्षम्.

क्षान्ति, इस्, f. patience, forbearance, endurance,
indulgence, patient waiting for anything.
—क्षान्ति-
मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, patient, enduring, indulgent.
—क्षान्ति-वादिन्, ई, m., N. of a Ṛṣi; N. of
Śākya-muni in one of his former births.

क्षान्तु, उस्, उस्, उ, patient, enduring; (उस्), m.
a father.

क्षमुद क्षमुद, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a
particular number.

क्षय क्षय. See under rt. 2. क्षि and rt.
4. क्षि, p. 266.

1. क्षय, अस्, m. (for 2. see under rt. 4. क्षि
below), an abode, residence, habitation, dwelling-
place, seat, house [cf. उरु-क्षय]; family, race;
the house of Yama, god of death; dominion (?).
—क्षय-तरु, उस्, m. the plant Bignonia Suave-
olens.

2. क्षय, अस्, m. (for 1. see under 2. क्षि last
col.), loss, waste, wane, diminution, destruction, decay
wasting or wearing away; fall (as of prices, opposed to
वृद्धि, e. g. क्षयो वृद्धिश् च पण्यानाम्, the
fall and rise in the price of commodities); removal;
end, termination (e. g. निद्रा-क्षय, the end of
sleep; दिन-क्षये, at the end of day; जीवित-
क्षये, at the end of life; क्षयं या or गम्, to
become less, be diminished, go to destruction, come
to an end, perish); consumption, pthisis pulmonalis;
sickness in general; the destruction of the universe;
(in algebra) a negative quality, a minus.
—क्षय-
कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing destruction or ruin, de-
structive, ruinous, terminating; liberating from ex-
istence.
—क्षय-काल, अस्, m. the end of all things,
the period of destruction.
—क्षय-कास, अस्, m. a
consumptive or phthisical cough.
—क्षय-कृत्, त्,
त्, त्, or क्षयङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing ruin or
loss; destructive.
—क्षय-नाशिनी, f. the plant
Celtis Orientalis, = जीवन्ती (‘removing consump-
tion’).
—क्षय-पक्ष, अस्, m. the dark fortnight,
that of the moon's wane.
—क्षय-युक्ति, इस्, f. or
क्षय-योग, अस्, m. necessity or opportunity of
destroying.
—क्षय-रोग, अस्, m. consumption.
—क्षयरोगि-त्व, अम्, n. or क्षयरोगि-ता, f.
consumption.
—क्षय-रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, consumptive.
—क्षय-वायु, उस्, m. the wind that is to blow at
[]
the end of the world.
—क्षय-सम्पद्, त्, f. total
loss, ruin, destruction.

क्षय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, perishable, decaying; [cf.
अ-क्षय्य.]

क्षयथु क्षयथु, उस्, m. cough; (a wrong
form for क्षवथु.)
क्षयथु, उस्, m. consumption.
क्षयद्वीर क्षयद्-वीर. See under 1. क्षि.

क्षर् क्षर्, cl. 1. P. क्षरति, चक्षार,
क्षरिष्यति, अक्षारीत्, क्षरितुम् (ep.
cl. 1. A. क्षरते, Ved. cl. 2. P. क्षरिति, Ved.
inf. क्षरध्यै), to flow, stream, glide; to flow
away; to stream forth; pour out (either in active
or neuter sense); to drop, distil, trickle, ooze,
run; to melt away, wane, perish, be destroyed; to
fall or slip from, to be deprived of (with abl.):
Caus. क्षारयति, -यितुम्: Desid. चिक्षरिषति:
Intens. चाक्षर्यते, चाक्षर्ति; [cf. Lat. scateo ?].

क्षर, अस्, आ, अम्, melting away, perishable;
(अस्), m. a cloud; (अम्), n. water; a body.
—क्षर-
ज or क्षरे-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by distillation.
—क्षर-पत्त्रा, f., N. of a plant, = द्रोण-पुष्पी.
—क्षर-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, mutable, dissoluble.

क्षार, अस्, आ, अम्, caustic, biting, corrosive, acid,
pungent, saline (according to some in these senses fr.
rt. क्षै), anything converted to alkali or ashes by
distillation; (अस्), m. juice, essence; treacle, molasses;
any corrosive or acid or saline substance, especially an
alkali such as soda or potash; caustic alkali, one
species of cautery; glass; a rogue, a cheat; (अम्),
[]
n. a factitious or medicinal salt, commonly black
salt [cf. विड्-लवण and कृष्ण-लवण]; water.
—क्षार-कर्दम, अस्, m. a pool of saline or acid
mud; N. of a hell.
—क्षार-कर्मन्, अ, n. apply-
ing caustic alkali (Lapis Infernalis) to proud flesh &c.;
or applying acid remedies in general.
—क्षार-
कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be treated with caustic alkali.
—क्षार-तैल, अम्, n. oil cooked with alkaline
ingredients.
—क्षार-त्रय or क्षार-त्रितय,
अम्, n. natron, saltpetre, and borax.
—क्षार-दला,
f. a kind of pot-herb, = चिल्ली.
—क्षार-द्रु, उस्, m.
the tree Bignonia Suaveolens; [cf. घण्टा-पाटलि.]
—क्षार-नदी, f. a river in hell, the water of which
is alkaline.
—क्षार-पत्त्र, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
or क्षार-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. the pot-herb Cheno-
podium Album.
—क्षार-पाल, अस्, m., N. of
a Ṛṣi.
—क्षार-भूमि, इस्, f. a saline soil.
—क्षार-मध्य, अस्, m. the plant Achyranthes
Aspera [cf. अपामार्ग]; its alkaline ashes make it
useful in washing clothes.
—क्षार-मृत्तिका, f.
saline soil, especially an impure sulphate of soda.
—क्षार-मेलक, अस्, m. an alkaline substance.
—क्षार-मेह, अस्, m. a morbid state of the urine,
in which its smell and taste resemble that of potash.
—क्षार-रस, अस्, m. a saline or alkaline flavour.
—क्षार-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the tree Bignonia Suave-
olens [cf. क्षार-द्रु]; any tree yielding abundant
potash.
—क्षार-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. the tree Butea
Frondosa; also = क्षार-वृक्ष; (अम्), n. alkaline
earth; [cf. वज्र-क्षार.]
—क्षार-षट्क, अम्,
n. six kinds of trees distinguished by their juice, as
the Butea Frondosa, Grislea Tomentosa, Achyranthes
Aspera, Cowach, Ghaṇṭā-pāṭali, Coraya.
—क्षार-
समुद्र, अस्, m. or क्षार-सिन्धु, उस्, m. the salt
ocean.
—क्षार-सूत्र, अम्, n. acid thread, applied
to fistulas &c.
—क्षाराक्ष (˚र-अक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having an artificial eye made of glass.
—क्षारागद
(˚र-अग्˚), अस्, m. remedy prepared by extracting the
alkaline particles from the ashes of plants.
—क्षा-
राच्छ (˚र-अच्छ), अम्, n. sea-salt.
—क्षाराञ्जन
(˚र-अञ्˚), अम्, n. an alkaline unguent.
—क्षा-
राम्बु (˚र-अम्˚), उ, n. or क्षारोद (˚र-उद), अस्,
m. or क्षारोदक (˚र-उद्˚), अम्, n. an alkaline
juice or fluid.
—क्षाराम्बुधि (˚र-अम्˚), क्षा-
रोदधि (˚र-उद्˚), इस्, m. the salt ocean.
क्षार क्षार. See under rt. क्षर्, p. 265.
क्षरक, अस्, इका, अम्, pouring forth.

क्षारक, अस्, m. alkali; a juice, essence; a
blossom, a new-blown flower or a young fruit; a
bud or a multitude of young buds; a cage or basket
or net for birds or fish; a washerman.

क्षरण, अम्, n. the act of flowing, trickling,
distilling, dropping (e. g. अङ्गुली-क्षरण, perspira-
tion of the fingers).

क्षारण, अम्, आ, n. f. accusing of unfaithfulness;
(अम्), n. converting to alkali or ashes; distilling.

क्षरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flowing, running, trickling,
oozing.

क्षरित, अस्, आ, अम्, dropped, liquefied, oozed,
trickling, flowing.

क्षारित, अस्, आ, अम्, distilled from saline matter,
strained through alkaline ashes &c.; calumniated,
falsely accused (especially of adultery), accused of a
crime, guilty.

क्षरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, flowing, dropping, trickling;
(ई), m. the rainy season.

क्षारय, nom. P. क्षारयति, -यितुम्, to fur-
nish or mix with acid substances; to torture a person
with acid substances; to speak ill of a person; to
abuse, accuse, calumniate.
क्षारिका, f. hunger.

क्षल् 1. क्षल्, cl. 1. P. क्षलति, -लितुम्,
to flow; to collect; [cf. क्षर्.]

क्षल् 2. क्षल् (related to rt. क्षर्), cl.
10. P. क्षालयति, अचिक्षलत्, -यितुम्,
to wash, wash off, purify, cleanse, clean, make clean;
to wipe away; [cf. Lith. skalauju, ‘to wash off;’
skalbju, ‘to wash;’ Mod. Germ. spüle?].

क्षालन, अम्, n. washing, washing off, cleansing
with water; sprinkling.
क्षालन क्षालन, &c. See under 2. क्षल्.

क्षालनीय or क्षालितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
washed, to be cleansed with water.

क्षालयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, washing, cleansing,
sprinkling.
क्षालित, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed, cleaned, washed.
क्षव क्षव. See under rt. 1. क्षु.

क्षव, अस्, m. sneezing, cough, catarrh; a black
species of mustard, Sinapis Dichotoma; [cf. राजिका.]
—क्षव-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, anything which causes sneez-
ing; making a sneeze, sneezing, coughing.

क्षात्रि, इस्, m. the son of a man of the second
caste (by a woman of another caste ?).

क्षामन् क्षामन्, अ, n. (occurring only in
nom., acc., loc. sing.), Ved. earth, soil, ground; [cf. 2.
क्षम्.]

क्षामाप्रस्थ क्षामा-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a
town.
क्षास् क्षास्, nom. case of 2. क्षम्, q. v.

क्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, possessing, ruling, govern-
ing.
—क्षयद्-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ruling or
governing men; an epithet of Indra, Rudra, and
Pūṣan; (Sāy. as if fr. 2. क्षि), possessed of abiding
or of going heroes such as sons &c.

2. क्षयण, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, annihilating,
driving away, dispersing; (often at the end of com-
pounds, e. g. असुर-क्षयण, पिशाच-क्षयण,
&c.)
क्षयस्, अस्, n. a dwelling-place, habitation.
क्षययितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be destroyed.

क्षयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, destroying, wasting, decay-
ing, perishing; perishable, fragile.

क्षवक, अस्, m. the plant Achyranthes Aspera,
= अपामार्ग, black mustard; (अम्), n. a kind of
pot-herb; (इका), f. a kind of Solanum; a species of
rice; a woman.

क्षवथु, उस्, m. sneezing; catarrh; cough;
irritation of the throat; sore throat.
